contexts.text: Racked to every particle of his joints.
Without these he cannot move a particle of his body. AE 98:3.
They cannot (then) move any material particle.
There is not the smallest particle in the human body which...
Relatively to the Grand Man, he is only the smallest particle... like a particle of air relatively to the whole atmosphere; or like a particle of water to the ocean.
Without this correspondence, the body does not live, not even a particle of it.
The part, nay, the particle, in which there is not life, becomes dead...
There is not a particle, or the least of a particle, in any member, organ, or viscus, which is not a use in form.
